2026-11-10

1 Abstract

vlm_app() opens a point-and-click application in the web browser. It needs the packages shiny, bslib and DT. Every example of the book loads with one click, and every result comes with a plain-language interpretation, the printed output, tables to copy or download, plots and the R code that repeats the analysis.

vlm_app(
    launch.browser = TRUE
  )

2 Pages

  • Data: the ten data sets of the book or a CSV file.
  • Model: fixed effects, random variance components, random coefficients per subject, a residual structure, estimation method, denominator degrees of freedom and test type. Load an example of the book fills every field for one of the 17 analyses of the book.
  • Means: least-squares means and their differences with Tukey, Bonferroni or Sidak adjustment.
  • Estimates: estimates and contrasts typed as in SAS, one per line, for example Samorin mean: intercept 1 Drug 0 1 dose 0.5 0.5 Drug:dose 0 0 0.5 0.5.
  • Random effects: best linear unbiased predictions.
  • Expected mean squares: the analysis of variance of PROC GLM with a RANDOM statement.
  • Compare: independent, compound symmetry, AR(1) and random coefficient structures for the fixed effects of the Model page.

3 Deployment

vlm_app_object() returns the application object, for example for a file app.R on a server: library(VetResearchLMM); vlm_app_object().
